game.title: Might and Magic Book One: The Secret of the Inner Sanctum (DOS)

shots.caption: Title: New World Computing presents Might and Magic, ESC to start / SPACE for scenes
Title, second picture: New World Computing presents Book One - Secret of the Inner Sanctum
Demo scene (SPACE on the title): discover a warrior's stronghold or a wizard's lair
Demo scene: an iron box opens, each share worth 38 gold, 10 gems found
After ESC on the title: are you ready? Then press Enter!
Options: create new characters, view all characters, go to town
Create new characters: seven statistics rolled, eligible classes, ENT to re-roll
Creation: class Knight chosen, select a race (Human, Elf, Dwarf, Gnome, Half-Orc)
Creation: select alignment (Good, Neut, Evil)
Creation: Knight, Human, Good, Male, name RYZ typed
Creation: SAVE CHARACTER (Y/N)?
View all characters: letter, name, town, level and class of the seven in the roster
Profile opened from the roster: new Knight RYZ with a Club, Ctrl-N re-name, Ctrl-D delete
Re-naming a character: NAME prompt under CONDI's profile
First control: inside the Inn of Sorpigal facing its door, commands panel, party of six
Sorpigal: sign above the door reads THE INN OF SORPIGAL
The innkeeper asks: would you like to sign in (Y/N)?
Signed in: Inn of Sorpigal, available characters, party marked with @
B and B Blacksmiths: a man wearing a leather apron speaks
Blacksmith: buy weapons, buy armor, buy misc, sell item; RYZ's gold
Blacksmith weapons: Dagger 5 ... Crossbow 50, Staff 30
Blacksmith armor: Small Shield 10 ... Chain Mail 200
Blacksmith misc: Torch 2, Rope & Hooks, Garlic, Magic Herbs, Might Potion, Scroll of Fire 300
RYZ's profile: statistics, HP, AC, gold, Short Sword and Leather Armor equipped, commands
RYZ's profile: equip which item A-F?
Share all: gems, gold or food split evenly among the party
Quick reference: hit points, spell points, armor class, food and condition of all six
Order: re-order the party by typing the old positions in the new order
Casting from a profile: MNZ enters level 1, number 5 (Leather Skin), Enter to cast
Protect: spells currently active, Leather Skin
Location spell (Sorcerer 1-7): in town, map sector C-2, surface and inside coordinates, facing
Rest here (Y/N)?
Rest complete: no encounters!
Sorpigal: a locked door (LOCKED!)
Unlock: who will try 1-6?
Encounter: four Poltergeists, picture, Attack / Bribe / Retreat / Surrender
Combat round 1: formation, monster list, handicap, a Poltergeist hacks at CONDI
Encounter option Bribe: no response
Encounter option Surrender: the monsters don't take prisoners!
Combat: options for MNZ the Sorcerer (Exchange, Retreat, Cast, Use, Block)
Combat: MNZ casts spell level 1, number 4 (Flame Arrow)
MNZ casts a spell: Poltergeist takes 5 points of damage
EBO shoots a Poltergeist with the sling: hit for 7 points, Poltergeist goes down
Victory: for defeating the monsters each survivor receives 100 experience points
Searching the room after the fight: nothing
A party at 1 hit point each: CUBI goes down, the last of the six
The shadow of death has fallen upon your party: renew the quest from the last inn
Otto's Training: training for level 2 costs 25 gold
Congratulations! You are now level 2, you gained 11 hit points
Training done: level 3 needs 1315 more experience points
RYZ after training: level 2, age 19, 26 hit points, 1808 gold left
Temple Moonshadow: restore health, uncurse items, restore align, make donation
Eulards Fine Foods: all you can eat, 5 gold each, will you pay?
Ye Olde Hogge Tavern: have a drink, tip bartender, listen for rumors
A statue's inscription: in memory of a time long ago...
A tenacious leprechaun offers travel to a town for one gem
Sorpigal: stairs going down, take them (Y/N)?
Below Sorpigal without light: DARKNESS
Cavern below Sorpigal after MNZ cast Light: green rock walls, a portcullis and a door
Cavern below Sorpigal: an elderly man behind a desk needs a courier service
Cavern: scrawled on the wall, a message reads: the jail above has many cells
Cavern, the Arena: balconies filled with cheering peasants, will you participate?
Cavern: a shimmering blue and white portal appears, enter?
Cavern encounter: five Skeletons
Cavern encounter: five Fire Ants
Cavern encounter: ten Snakes
Outside Sorpigal: mountains and forest
Sector C-2, forest: a glowing white column, touch it?
Sector C-2, dense woods: a strange fountain, drink?
Sector C-2: statues block the path, smash them?
Wilderness encounter in the forest: nine Strangling Vines
Sector C-2: a toothless gypsy seer offers to read a character's sign
Sector C-2, mountains: there's a cave here, enter?
Sector A-1: surrounded by the Dark Rider and his men, he challenges you to a duel
Sector A-1: carved on a block of ice, start at 15-7 and walk to Doom
Sector A-1: the fabled Castle Doom, will you enter?
Sector E-1, south edge: mountains beside a red expanse
Sector E-1, mountains: ruins of Castle Dragadune, enter?
Portsmith: a sign above the door reads Inn of Portsmith
Inn of Portsmith: Lara, the innkeeper's daughter, asks if you will be spending the night
Signed in at town 2: Inn of Portsmith, the six characters now lodge here
Portsmith, B. Smith's Workshop: a young girl forging a long sword
Portsmith: Zam, astral brother of Zom: you're not the couriers!
Portsmith: a sensuous female voice from an intoxicating mist; the men of the party are marked
The Inn of Algary: a tall bearded half-orc behind a large desk
Algary: Morango the Mystic asks whom to measure
Algary: a magic portal, enter?
The Inn of Dusk: an eerie silence, a ghostly apparition asks to sign in
Dusk, Clearman's Training: several empty suits of armor approach
Dusk: a gold chest: open it, find/remove trap, detect magic/trap
Gold chest, open it: who will try 1-6?
The chest opens for CUBI the Robber: 200 gems and an Undead Amulet found
Dusk encounter: ten Vampires
Dusk encounter: ten Banshees
Erliquin: the wizard Agar speaks: I have no business with you. Begone!
The Inn of Erliquin: an elderly gnome adjusting his spectacles asks about signing in
Erliquin: three huge armor clad knights bark in unison, want a good workout?
Castle Alamar: castle guards exclaim, no merchants pass! Begone peasants
Castle Alamar: a fair maiden weeps in a steel cage: set free, torment or leave
Castle Alamar, the throne room: the king sends the party to find the Crypt of Carmenca
Castle Doom: a golden door repels you!
Castle Doom: the true King Alamar, held in a forcefield, tells of the impostor and the Eye of Goros
Castle White Wolf: Lord Ironfist speaks: your services are needed! Accept?
Lord Ironfist's first quest: find the stronghold in Ravens Wood
Castle White Wolf: a banner and a button on the wall, push it?
Quivering Forest: the wizard Okrim with three Wizards and a Brontasaurus
Quivering Forest encounter: Pyro Hydras, Man Eating Mares, 8 and 12 Headed Hydras
Quivering Forest: the floor spins!
Astral Plane: there's a small slot in the door. No admittance!
Astral Plane: astral projector # 1, zap!
Astral Plane: the metallic room is dimly lit by a pulsating white glow
Inner Sanctum: a metallic panel slides open, a mysterious man in a white coat
Inner Sanctum: the Data Keeper rates the party and sends it to the Gates to Another World
